nodes.name: import-woocommerce.mjs
nodes.summary: Idempotent CLI importer that reads the WooCommerce product CSV export, merges English/French translations and color data, re-hosts product images as WebP in S3 storage, and upserts products and variants into Postgres (supports --dry-run).

nodes.name: htmlToText
nodes.summary: Converts WooCommerce HTML descriptions into plain text with line breaks and decoded entities.

nodes.name: sizeRank
nodes.summary: Computes a sort rank for size labels (numeric and S/M/L style) so variants are ordered consistently.

nodes.name: productCategory
nodes.summary: Maps a WooCommerce product to its target category in the catalog.

nodes.name: worker
nodes.summary: Concurrent upload worker that downloads, resizes and uploads product images to the products bucket.

nodes.name: ensureLookup
nodes.summary: Ensures lookup rows (e.g. colors or sizes) exist in a table, inserting missing names and returning their ids.

nodes.name: old-colissimo.mjs
nodes.summary: One-off, re-runnable importer that loads Colissimo parcels and payouts from the legacy tools' CSV exports into deliveries, then calls import_colissimo_history to create COL- orders, customers and payout records.

nodes.name: parseCsv
nodes.summary: Minimal RFC-style CSV parser handling quoted fields, escaped quotes and embedded newlines, returning objects keyed by header.

nodes.name: run-next.mjs
nodes.summary: Launcher that sets NODE_OPTIONS with a longer network-family autoselection timeout and spawns the Next.js CLI, forwarding arguments and exit codes.

nodes.name: shims-supabase.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient module declaration that types @supabase/supabase-js as any, a leftover shim from the Supabase era.

nodes.name: linked-project.json
nodes.summary: Supabase CLI cache recording the linked hosted project ref, name and organization (legacy, from before the move off Supabase).

nodes.name: gotrue-version
nodes.summary: Supabase CLI cache file holding the linked project's GoTrue (Supabase Auth) version; generated metadata, not used by the app.

nodes.name: pooler-url
nodes.summary: Supabase CLI cache file holding the linked project's connection pooler URL; generated metadata, not used by the app.

nodes.name: postgres-version
nodes.summary: Supabase CLI cache file holding the linked project's Postgres version; generated metadata, not used by the app.

nodes.name: project-ref
nodes.summary: Supabase CLI cache file holding the linked project's linked project reference; generated metadata, not used by the app.

nodes.name: rest-version
nodes.summary: Supabase CLI cache file holding the linked project's PostgREST version; generated metadata, not used by the app.

nodes.name: storage-migration
nodes.summary: Supabase CLI cache file holding the linked project's Storage migration marker; generated metadata, not used by the app.

nodes.name: storage-version
nodes.summary: Supabase CLI cache file holding the linked project's Storage API version; generated metadata, not used by the app.
